style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI, cozy office game top-down three-quarter orthographic view. Big head 38-42 percent of body height, minimum one third. Highlighted expressive eyes, NEVER plain dots. Dark warm plum-brown selective one-pixel outline; warm readable limited palette, 3-4 hard-edged tones per material. Deliberate chunky square pixel clusters at a logical 32x64 design scale; no vector curves, gradients, antialiasing or dithering. Target full-body silhouette about 26x46 logical pixels including bun/pencil, preserve eye highlights at final resolution. Uniform pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no magenta in subject. Lilac is muted and grayish, never saturated purple/magenta. No scenery, floor shadow, furniture, grid, text or detached marks. IDENTITY LOCK: Kind elderly woman with a gently plump pear-shaped body and a large round head. Silver-gray hair swept back with a scalloped side fringe and ONE prominent round bun high at the back, ONE golden-yellow pencil diagonally through the bun; the bun remains visible above/behind the head in every view. Large warm brown expressive eyes, each at least 3x4 logical pixels with an ivory square catchlight, visible THROUGH thin dark-brown ROUND glasses. Two small gold chain strands hang from the glasses to collar level. Warm peach skin, rosy cheeks, a tiny gentle smile and subtle crow-foot pixels. Dusty LILAC knitted triangular shawl, broad over both shoulders with two short pointed front ends, over a cream ankle-length floral dress with sparse terracotta flowers and muted blue-green leaves. Short comfortable brown rounded shoes. Rounded broad shawl and flared skirt form a strong triangular silhouette; no trousers, no blazer, no beanie, no apron. Keep the same gray bun/pencil, round glasses/chain, lilac shawl, cream floral dress and brown shoes in EVERY state and direction. Back views show the bun and full triangular shawl; no face.
